FUNERAL_SEAL_AFFLICTION.title: Seal
FUNERAL_SEAL_AFFLICTION.description: This card is sealed and cannot be played. Remove this Affliction when the card leaves your hand, is discarded, is Exhausted, or when the player's turn ends.
